description: The line plot illustrates the BPC (Bits Per Character) values for two models, SMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating, as a function of training steps. The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps," ranges from 0 to 50,000 (indicated as 50 on the axis with the notation (x10³)), and is marked at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled "BPC," ranges from 1.2 to 2.2 and is marked at intervals of 0.2. The black line, representing SMoE Validating, starts at a BPC of approximately 2.2 at 0 training steps and decreases sharply to around 1.2 by 20,000 steps, after which it remains relatively flat. The purple line, representing SimSMoE Validating, begins at a BPC of about 2.2 and also decreases rapidly, reaching a value of approximately 1.2 by 20,000 steps, where it then stabilizes and remains nearly constant. Both lines converge and show similar performance after the initial training phase.
